source.title: feat(desktop): cloud-only settings panel with hardened Cloud contracts

reason: The exact-head review found that a broad Settings rewrite introduced 24 static translation keys absent from the canonical English catalog and carried an exact-head Biome failure, while also correctly withholding visual acceptance for a large UI change. The author explicitly credited the review, added all 24 catalog entries in commit 16b880c51d61759a0d2d3ced27928e15a37c1e44, fixed the formatter failure, and later obtained green exact-head hosted checks before merge. The award is bounded because the visual-evidence request remained unresolved at merge and this review did not claim the deeper contract repairs supplied by other reviewers.
